historicalReuse: All historical periods have already been reviewed. This is chronological research, not an untouched holdout or live record.

targets.stocks: Next available SPY session open to close; assumes publication before that open.
targets.crypto: BTC full UTC session source date + 2 calendar days, open to close; no borrowing the partially elapsed publication-day return.

trainingLabelRule: Target close date must be strictly before prediction source date; extra one-source-session embargo. Production comparator additionally requires matured three-session labels.
ridgeRefit: First eligible source date of each calendar month, using only then-mature labels and training-only standardization.
features: Production stationarized six-feature vector plus 1/5/20/60-session own returns and trailing 20-session daily volatility; no news, future prices or parameter search.
tradingDiagnostic: Common session open-to-close, fully closed each session, unit long/short exposure. Forecast-driven challengers trade only above fixed round-trip cost. Raw production uses its existing market-label boundary; filtered comparator uses actual permission. Risk and exposure differ; do not rank profitability without them.
riskForecast: EWMA of matured target squared returns, decay 0.94, versus rolling-training constant variance. Evaluate QLIKE and absolute-return MAE with RMS-to-absolute normal conversion explicitly approximate.
promotion: No automatic promotion. Require improvement over base return/probability forecasts, no deterioration in recent and annual slices, cost-robust economic benefit, then locked prospective evidence. Historical selection can never satisfy the prospective requirement.
prospective: Freeze recipe and code/data fingerprints. Write dated predictions before their target opens and append outcomes only after close; no backfilled prediction counts as prospective. No production policy change in this experiment.
